description: Validates authorized penetration testing: scoped engagement, tool selection per phase, final reporting with evidence and remediation.

criteria: Written scope and rules of engagement precede exploitation
Findings backed by evidence with severity and remediation

test_cases.input: Plan an authorized penetration test against a web application. Define the scope, rules of engagement, and the reconnaissance to enumeration phase plan.
expected_behaviors: produces a written scope with explicit authorization boundaries
includes rules of engagement (no persistence, no production impact, defined window)
provides a phased methodology from reconnaissance to enumeration with OWASP WSTG phases

test_cases.input: Given a scoped and authorized engagement, choose the right tooling for each phase (reconnaissance, enumeration, vulnerability analysis) and justify each selection.
expected_behaviors: maps phases to appropriate tools (e.g. nmap for recon/enumeration, ffuf or gobuster for content discovery, nuclei or Burp Suite for vulnerability analysis)
justifies each selection against the scope
reminds that all activity is confined to the written scope

test_cases.input: Produce the final penetration test report from an engagement: findings, evidence, risk ratings, and remediation.
expected_behaviors: structures the report with executive summary, findings with evidence, severity/risk rating, and concrete remediation
does not overstate impact beyond observed evidence
